instance.basis: FICTIONAL. An anonymous web-form tip (low credibility, no corroboration) claims a former associate is 'watching every move' of a named executive through live event feeds and social check-ins, and 'knows exactly when to catch him alone.' The content is alarming and the claimed target is specific, but nothing beyond the tip itself is established: no capability, no trajectory, no access. Source credibility acts as the brake the contract defines — the raise waits for corroboration while the type-high band still floors the case; the alarming instance cannot be dismissed and cannot stampede the queue.
